npcs.name: Aurelian Vesk
npcs.greet: Mind the papers. No, not those. Those are filed. By a system. Mine.

npcs.name: Thyra Gull-Wife
npcs.greet: If you've come to sell me a charm against bad dreams, keep walking. I've bought enough.

npcs.name: Hallvard
npcs.greet: Twenty planks every Loredas, and not one of them for my own roof.

npcs.name: Ysolde Frost-Hand
npcs.greet: Listen. Do you hear it? No. Of course not. The tide's too high.

npcs.name: Dravyn Dalvilu
npcs.greet: Another Nord who wants to tell me to go home? Ask Red Mountain where home is.

npcs.name: Thorkel the Lucky
npcs.greet: Lucky. Ha. They still call me that. Buy me a drink and I'll tell you how lucky.

npcs.name: Ragnhild Keel-Wright
npcs.greet: Mind the shavings. A keel's no good with a stranger's boot-print in it.

relics.name: Septimus's Frozen Letter
relics.desc: A letter to the College in a cramped, feverish hand, frozen stiff in a lost courier's satchel.

relics.name: Faldrus's Focus Crystal
relics.desc: A finger-length crystal etched with a College master's sigil. It still smells faintly of lightning.

relics.name: Red-Knotted Strongbox
relics.desc: A sealed box marked with a red knot, heavy with Legion pay. The lock has been tried and has held.

relics.name: Arm-Ring of the Five Hundred
relics.desc: A heavy bronze arm-ring green with sea-rot, said to have been worn by one of Ysgramor's Companions.

relics.name: Dalvilu Ancestor Urn
relics.desc: A small ash-urn of Dunmer make, sealed with wax and wrapped in a child's shawl.

relics.name: Ingrith's Wedding Ring
relics.desc: A plain silver ring, worn thin on one side by thirty years of nets and oars.

relics.name: Surveyor's Satchel
relics.desc: A leather satchel holding a three-quarters finished map of High Gate Ruins and a broken pencil.

relics.name: Concordance of the Unquiet
relics.desc: A restricted College volume bound in grey leather. Its margins are full of Vinicia's notes.

relics.name: Nirvel's Purse
relics.desc: A fat purse of Dawnstar coin, every septim of it paid for a sachet that did nothing.

relics.name: Eyvind's Amulet of Kyne
relics.desc: A worn amulet of Kyne on a frayed cord, once his mother's.

relics.name: Frostflow Lens
relics.desc: The great cracked lens of the Frostflow lamp, scratched by claws but still whole.

relics.name: Iron-Breaker Strongbox
relics.desc: The Dawnstar mine's ore-money box, dented by a giant's heel. It is lighter than it should be.

relics.name: Torbjorn's Silver Hammer
relics.desc: A tiny silver hammer on a chain, a miner's luck-charm handed from father to son.

relics.name: Dwemer Regulating Rod
relics.desc: A brass rod as long as a forearm. It hums faintly when held, a note that never quite ends.

relics.name: Gerdir's Silver Band
relics.desc: A plain silver wedding band, taken from a fresh grave.

relics.name: Bell of the Drowned Temple
relics.desc: A small bronze bell, green with sea-rot, hauled up from the drowned temple of old Winterhold.

relics.name: Antler Cradle-Charm
relics.desc: A charm of carved antler bound with a thread of red wool, forty years on the midwives' cairn.

relics.name: Legion Dispatch Case
relics.desc: A leather case stamped with the Imperial dragon, holding troop dispositions for the Pale.

relics.name: Two Pieces of the Luck-Stone
relics.desc: Two shards of a river stone that fit together along a jagged seam. A third piece is missing.

relics.name: Tablet of the White Strand
relics.desc: A slate tablet carved with the lost closing verse of a Dawnstar saga.

relics.name: Bear-and-Axe Banner
relics.desc: A Stormcloak company banner stitched by the women of Windhelm, stiff with frost.

relics.name: Sea-Wolf Prow Carving
relics.desc: A wolf's head in black oak, from the prow of the ship that carried Yngol to his death.

relics.name: Heartwood of the Grove
relics.desc: A pale, warm length of living wood cut from the eldest tree of the Shrouded Grove.

relics.name: Raldbthar Tonal Regulator
relics.desc: A brass rod in a cradle of struts that hums a low, steady note when touched.

relics.name: Hillgrund's Drinking Horn
relics.desc: An ancient horn rimmed in silver and carved with ravens.

quests.title: Twenty Planks a Week
quests.desc: Grelka Iron-Jaw, the bandit chief of Fort Kastav, is bleeding Anga's Mill dry with her timber tribute. Hallvard at the mill would pay to see it stopped.
quests.pitch: The Kastav bandits take half of what Anga's Mill cuts. Hallvard says he'd give his saw to see Grelka gone. Well, not his saw. But something.

objectives.text: Go to Fort Kastav
Put an end to Grelka Iron-Jaw
objectives.journal: Grelka is dead. The self-styled Lady of Kastav will collect no more tolls.

objectives.text: Tell Hallvard at Anga's Mill
objectives.topic: Grelka won't be collecting any more planks.
objectives.reply: No more tribute? Then this winter we patch our own roofs first. Here, it's not much, but it's honest timber money.

quests.outro: Anga's Mill sends its timber to Windhelm again, and for once the planks stay on the right side of the road.

quests.title: A Letter Down the Crevasse
quests.desc: The courier who supplies Septimus Signus lost the old scholar's letter to the College down a crevasse near the outpost. Ice wraiths guard the ice below.
quests.pitch: Jorlief the courier dropped some letter of that mad old Imperial down a crack in the glacier. He won't go back for it. Can't say I blame him.

objectives.text: Find the lost letter in the crevasse near the outpost
objectives.journal: The letter is frozen stiff but legible. It is addressed to the College of Winterhold.

objectives.text: Deliver the letter to Quaestor Vesk at the College
objectives.reply: From Signus? Gods. He writes once a decade and always about the same box. Still, his last letter was right about three things I was wrong about. I shall read it in private. And then I shall be insufferable.

quests.outro: Vesk spends a week muttering about Dwemer locks. The courier is very glad it is no longer his problem.

quests.title: Hela's Plate
quests.desc: Captain Hela of the frozen ship Hela's Folly hid a strongbox of silver plate ashore before her crew died in the ice. Her last note describes where.
quests.pitch: They say the captain of Hela's Folly buried her cargo somewhere on the shore before the ice took her. Nobody's ever found it. Nobody's tried very hard, either.

objectives.text: Board the wreck of Hela's Folly
Dig up the plate by the crooked doorway of rock
objectives.journal: Wrapped in an old mainsail, weighted with the ship's bell: Hela's silver plate. Most of it is tarnished past saving, but a fine silver ring was packed among it.

quests.outro: You drink to Hela Wave-Bride, who was right about the route and wrong about the weather.

quests.title: Lightning in the Temple
quests.desc: A College novice spent a night in the Skytemple Ruins on a dare and dropped his master's focus crystal down the inner stair. Something in the ruins speaks with the storm.
quests.pitch: One of the College students went up to the Skytemple Ruins on a dare. Lost something precious down there, they say. And there's been lightning over the ruins on clear nights since.

objectives.text: Find the focus crystal on the inner stair
Silence the storm in the inner altar
objectives.journal: The thing that spoke in the stones was a storm spirit bound to the old altar. The lightning has stopped.

objectives.text: Return the crystal to Quaestor Vesk
objectives.topic: Your novice dropped this in the Skytemple Ruins.
objectives.reply: Faldrus? He crawled back to the College two days ago with frostbitten ears and a vow of silence. So that is where my crystal went. I shall make him write an essay on it. Thirty pages. With footnotes.

quests.outro: Faldrus survives his essay. The wager with Onmund remains, by mutual agreement, void.

quests.title: The Red Knot
quests.desc: The wrecked Brinehammer carried three months of Legion pay in barrels marked with a red knot. Salvagers led by Ulfgar Wet-Boots mean to take it before the Legion knows.
quests.pitch: The Legion lads at the coast camp haven't been paid in months, and there's a crew of divers working the Brinehammer wreck. You do the arithmetic.

objectives.text: Deal with Ulfgar Wet-Boots and his salvagers
Recover the red-knotted strongbox from the flooded hold
Return the pay to the Pale Imperial Camp
objectives.journal: Quartermaster Ostorian counted every coin twice, then a third time, then cried a little.

quests.outro: The camp is paid, and for one night the coast echoes with Legion drinking songs.

quests.title: The Pilgrim's Arm-Ring
quests.desc: Brother Aslaug of Windhelm drowned in Pilgrim's Trench carrying a relic arm-ring meant for Ysgramor's Tomb. His letter says it lies in an iron box under his bunk.
quests.pitch: Three pilgrim ships went down in the trench off the coast, carrying offerings for Ysgramor. One of them had a real Companion's arm-ring aboard, so the priests in Windhelm say.

objectives.text: Find the iron box under Brother Aslaug's bunk
objectives.journal: The arm-ring was still in its box, wrapped in a pilgrim's prayer cloth.

objectives.text: Lay the arm-ring at the door of Ysgramor's Tomb
objectives.journal: The arm-ring rests on the Harbinger's doorstep, as Brother Aslaug intended.

quests.outro: Fishermen say that on the night you laid the ring, the wind off the trench sounded like many voices singing.

quests.title: Ashes for a Father
quests.desc: A Dunmer girl's diary from the wreck of the Pride of Tel Vos tells of her father's ancestor-urn, hidden in the captain's cabin. Her brother Dravyn still lives in Winterhold.
quests.pitch: Looters are picking over the Pride of Tel Vos again. The Dunmer in town hate it. One of them, Dravyn, says his family's ancestor-urn is still aboard.

objectives.text: Find the urn in the captain's chest with the spiral lock
objectives.journal: The urn is sealed and whole, wrapped in a child's shawl.

objectives.text: Bring the urn to Dravyn Dalvilu in Winterhold
objectives.topic: I found your father's urn on the Pride of Tel Vos.
objectives.reply: That shawl was Nivera's. She was nine. She wrapped it herself, on a sinking ship, so Father would not be cold. ...Forgive me. Give me a moment.

objectives.text: Tell Dravyn what else was aboard
objectives.topic: The purser hid Telvanni soul gems in the hold.
objectives.reply: Master Dren's gems. He was paid in full to carry us, and he would have thrown us overboard to save the weight. What would you have me do with them?

choices.label: Sell them for the refugees of Winterhold
choices.reply: Then the Telvanni will feed the people they nearly drowned. That is a justice even Azura would smile at. Take a share for yourself, I insist.

choices.label: Leave them in the sea where they belong
choices.reply: Yes. Let the sea keep the Master's treasure, as it kept so much of ours. I would not want to profit from that ship.

quests.outro: Dravyn sets the urn in the little shrine of his house. On Morndas he takes it to the Shrine of Azura, so that his father may see the dawn.

quests.title: The Wedding on the Island
quests.desc: Ingrith, a Dawnstar fisherwoman, rowed out to Yngvild in a waking dream. Her sister Thyra fears she was called by whatever lives on the island.
quests.pitch: Thyra Gull-Wife's sister rowed out to Yngvild in the middle of the night. Talking about a wedding. Thyra's offering everything she has to whoever goes after her.

objectives.text: Search Yngvild for Ingrith
Destroy the master of Yngvild
objectives.journal: The Host of Yngvild is dead. Ingrith was among his 'bridesmaids'. She did not suffer long.

objectives.text: Recover Ingrith's wedding ring
Bring the ring to Thyra Gull-Wife in Dawnstar
objectives.topic: I'm sorry. This is all that was left of Ingrith.
objectives.reply: ...She always said she'd be buried at sea. Now she'll be buried with Father, on the hill. Take the sword. My husband would have wanted it swung at something worse than herring.

quests.outro: Thyra buries the ring beside her father. The lights on Yngvild do not burn again.

quests.title: The Unfinished Map
quests.desc: Surveyor Decimus Calvo of the Imperial Geographic Society went deeper into High Gate Ruins to finish his map. His satchel holds the only copy.
quests.pitch: There was an Imperial mapmaker went into High Gate Ruins. Wouldn't leave without finishing his map. I suppose he's finished now, one way or the other.

objectives.text: Find Decimus Calvo's survey satchel
objectives.journal: Calvo died at his drawing board in the last chamber, pencil still in hand. The map is finished except for one room.

objectives.text: Defeat the gate-warden of the old cult
Bring the map to the Legion at the Pale Imperial Camp

quests.outro: The Society will publish Calvo's map with a black border. The last room is marked simply: 'Do not.'

quests.title: The Concordance of the Unquiet
quests.desc: Vinicia Sallus, expelled from the College for necromancy, stole a restricted book from the Arcanaeum and now raises the drowned in Hob's Fall Cave.
quests.pitch: There's a woman in Hob's Fall raising the drowned. The College threw her out years back. Now the Legion patrols keep disappearing and turning up on the beach, standing in the surf.

objectives.text: Enter Hob's Fall Cave
Stop Vinicia Sallus
Recover the Concordance of the Unquiet
Return the book to the College through Quaestor Vesk
objectives.topic: The Concordance of the Unquiet, from Hob's Fall.
objectives.reply: Oh, the Arcanaeum's keeper will be thrilled. Thrilled is perhaps strong. He will grunt slightly less. I always said she had talent. I also always said she would end badly. I dislike being right about both.

quests.outro: The Legion camp's lost patrols are buried properly this time, on land.

quests.title: Charms Against the Dark
quests.desc: Nirvel Twice-Sworn sells useless 'dream-ward' sachets to the sleepless folk of Dawnstar, and keeps his takings in Windward Ruins.
quests.pitch: That charm-seller who's been fleecing Dawnstar? He's holed up in Windward Ruins with a pack of thugs. Thyra Gull-Wife's been asking around about him.

objectives.text: Confront Nirvel Twice-Sworn in Windward Ruins
Take back the sachet money
Bring the money to Thyra Gull-Wife in Dawnstar
objectives.topic: Here's what Nirvel took from Dawnstar.
objectives.reply: Seven hundred septims for a bag of salt and weeds. I'll see every family gets theirs back. Gods know we can't buy a good night's sleep with it, but we can buy bread.

quests.outro: Dawnstar still dreams of the black door. But at least now it dreams with its coin back.

quests.title: The Digger's Amulet
quests.desc: Eyvind Frost-Hand, a hired digger, was lost in the lower halls of Saarthal in 4E 189. His sister Ysolde still lives in Winterhold.
quests.pitch: Ysolde Frost-Hand's brother went into Saarthal with the College diggers twelve years back. They sealed the halls with him still inside. She's never forgiven them.

objectives.text: Search Saarthal's lower halls for Eyvind
Find Eyvind's amulet of Kyne
objectives.journal: Eyvind's bones lay against a sealed door, the amulet still in his fist.

objectives.text: Bring the amulet to Ysolde Frost-Hand
objectives.topic: Eyvind didn't make it out of Saarthal. He was holding this.
objectives.reply: Mother's amulet. He said the College paid better than the sea. They both took him in the end. Thank you for bringing him home. Even this much of him.

quests.outro: Ysolde hangs the amulet on the cliff-post where she listens for the drowned bell.

quests.title: The White Cat
quests.desc: Grunnar Bear-Tooth went into Bleakcoast Cave to kill a great white sabre cat and never came out. The Jarl's bounty still stands.
quests.pitch: There's a white sabre cat in Bleakcoast Cave that killed Grunnar, the best hunter in Winterhold. The Jarl's offering ten septims a tooth. Big cat, lots of teeth.

objectives.text: Hunt down the white sabre cat
objectives.journal: The white cat is dead. Grunnar lay deep in her den, his grandfather's bow still across his knees.

objectives.text: Claim the Jarl's bounty in Winterhold

quests.outro: The furrier in Winterhold makes a fine coat from the white pelt. You leave Frostsinger with Grunnar, as he asked.

quests.title: The Dark Lamp
quests.desc: The keeper of Frostflow Lighthouse followed something that stole his lens down into the tunnels beneath the tower. The light has been dark for nine nights.
quests.pitch: Frostflow Lighthouse has gone dark and the keeper's gone missing. A ship nearly broke on the point last week. Somebody needs to get that lamp burning.

objectives.text: Clear the tunnels beneath the lighthouse
Recover the lighthouse lens
objectives.journal: The Falmer had set the lens up in their den like an idol. Keeper Eirik's axe lay beside it.

objectives.text: Set the lens back in the lamp
objectives.journal: The Frostflow light burns again over the Sea of Ghosts.

quests.outro: Captain Hjolfrid's ship passes the point safely that night. She does not write a thank-you letter. She does not burn your furniture either.

quests.title: The Cartographer's Purse
quests.desc: Brynja Stormquill, a cartographer mapping the north for the College, buried an emergency purse behind Journeyman's Nook.
quests.pitch: That mapmaker woman, Stormquill, she used to stop at Journeyman's Nook. Swore she'd hidden a purse out there for hard times. Haven't seen her in a while.

objectives.text: Dig under the flat rock north of the Nook
objectives.journal: Under the flat rock: Brynja's purse, a gold ring and a note. 'If you're reading this and I'm alive, run.'

quests.outro: Somewhere in the north, Brynja Stormquill is probably very annoyed.

quests.title: The Giant's Footstool
quests.desc: Leif the sled-master abandoned the Iron-Breaker Mine's ore-money strongbox at the giant camp in Red Road Pass. The giants are using it as a footstool.
quests.pitch: The Dawnstar mine's money box is sitting by a giant's fire in Red Road Pass. The foreman wants it back. The sled-master who lost it wants to be left alone.

objectives.text: Recover the strongbox from the giants' fire
objectives.journal: The strongbox is lighter than a month's ore money ought to be. The lock is scratched as if picked, long before the giants found it.

objectives.text: Bring the strongbox to the mine foreman in Dawnstar
objectives.journal: The foreman weighed the box, opened it, and went looking for Leif. The ore that went missing between the pit and the boats had found its way into the strongbox's lining. Leif had a silver brooch to explain.

quests.outro: Leif is no longer the sled-master. The giants, you suspect, miss their footstool.

quests.title: Torbjorn's Hammer
quests.desc: The Falmer dragged miner Torbjorn Coal-Eye from Whistling Mine into the Sightless Pit. His wife wants his luck-charm back, whatever is left of him.
quests.pitch: Falmer took a miner from Whistling Mine down into the Sightless Pit. His wife's asking for his luck-charm back. Brave folk only.

objectives.text: Find Torbjorn's silver hammer in the Sightless Pit
objectives.journal: Torbjorn was beyond help. The Falmer had hung his silver hammer over their shrine, as if it were holy.

objectives.text: Bring the charm to Torbjorn's crew at Whistling Mine

quests.outro: The miners pass the little hammer from hand to hand, then send it to Torbjorn's widow with a month of their own wages.

quests.title: The Quaestor's Assistant
quests.desc: Brelas Indarys, assistant to Quaestor Aurelian Vesk, took a Dwemer regulating rod from the great coil in Alftand. Then something below started clicking.
quests.pitch: Quaestor Vesk at the College sent his assistant into Alftand. The boy never came back. Vesk pretends he isn't worried. He's worried.

objectives.text: Search Alftand for Brelas
Recover the regulating rod from Brelas's satchel
objectives.journal: Brelas died in a pipe gallery with his satchel clutched to his chest. The rod still hums.

objectives.text: Bring the rod and the news to Quaestor Vesk
objectives.topic: Brelas is dead. He kept this safe to the end.
objectives.reply: ...He would. He was always more careful with the artefacts than with himself. I sent him there. I shall carry that, and I shall put his name on the paper, first, above mine. Leave me now. Please.

quests.outro: Vesk's next memorandum to the Arch-Mage is titled 'On the Alftand Coil, by Brelas Indarys and A. Vesk'.

quests.title: What Whistles in the Dark
quests.desc: Miners at Whistling Mine broke into an ice pocket, and the ice wraiths inside have frozen two men at the ore face. The foreman offers a month's ore money.
quests.pitch: Whistling Mine's shut. Ice wraiths in the lower gallery. Skuli the foreman's offering a month of ore money to anyone who clears them out.

objectives.text: Clear the ice wraiths from the lower gallery
Destroy the great wraith in the ice pocket
objectives.journal: The whistling has stopped. Now it is only the wind again.

quests.outro: The miners go back to work, singing loudly, in case anything else down there was listening.

quests.title: Gerdir's Ring
quests.desc: Grave-robbers in Frostmere Crypt stole a wedding band from the fresh grave of Gerdir, wife of Sigvald. Their chief, Kjeld the Gravewolf, refuses to sell it back.
quests.pitch: The robbers in Frostmere Crypt took old Sigvald's dead wife's ring right off her finger. He's been leaving them notes. They've been laughing.

objectives.text: Deal with Kjeld the Gravewolf
Recover Gerdir's ring
Leave the ring at the cairn on the crypt road for Sigvald
objectives.journal: Under the cairn lay forty septims and a note: 'For whoever is kinder than the last.' You leave the ring and take the coin.

quests.outro: Gerdir's grave is closed again. Sigvald wears her ring on a cord around his neck.

quests.title: The Drowned Bell
quests.desc: Rolff Thin-Fingers, a fence at Fort Fellhammer, bought a bronze bell hauled up from the drowned temple of old Winterhold. Ysolde Frost-Hand has been searching for it.
quests.pitch: There's a fence at Fort Fellhammer selling a bell they say came up from the drowned temple. Ysolde Frost-Hand's been asking every trader in the hold about it.

objectives.text: Deal with Rolff Thin-Fingers and his guards
Find the bell of the drowned temple
Bring the bell to Ysolde Frost-Hand in Winterhold
objectives.topic: The bell from the drowned temple.
objectives.reply: Three strokes, slow, the way they rang it for the dead. I'll hang it on the cliff where the temple stood. Let the sea hear it ring from this side for once.

quests.outro: On the lowest tide of Evening Star, Ysolde rings the bell three times. Some swear they hear an answer from beneath the water.

quests.title: Light the Beacon
quests.desc: Snowpoint Beacon has stood dark for twenty years, since a wraith out of the ice froze its watchman at the top of the stair.
quests.pitch: Snowpoint Beacon's been dark for twenty years. Old Ulf says the watchman's still standing at the top, frozen. If you ever lit it again, they'd see it from Fort Dunstad.

objectives.text: Destroy the wraith that haunts the beacon
objectives.journal: When the wraith broke apart, the ice fell from the watchman at the top of the stair. Hrongar can be buried at last.

objectives.text: Light the beacon fire
objectives.journal: The beacon burns over the snowfields for the first time in twenty years.

quests.outro: At Fort Dunstad, the night watch sees the fire on Snowpoint and nearly sounds the alarm, out of old habit.

quests.title: The Shepherd's Dragon
quests.desc: A grey dragon has made its roost on the word wall of Mount Anthor and is devouring the flocks of the high pastures. A shepherd's son means to fight it with an axe.
quests.pitch: There's a dragon sitting on the old wall up on Mount Anthor, eating every sheep in the valley. Ragna's boy wants to go up with an axe. Somebody had better get there first.

objectives.text: Climb Mount Anthor
Slay the dragon of Mount Anthor
objectives.journal: The dragon of Mount Anthor is dead. Ragna's son will have to find something else to fight.

quests.outro: Ragna gives back her son's axe. He has decided to become a shepherd after all.

quests.title: The Cradle-Charm
quests.desc: Something in Stillborn Cave has been taking the midwives' charms from the cairn at its mouth, including Gudrun Warm-Hands' grandmother's antler cradle-charm.
quests.pitch: The midwives' charms keep disappearing from the cairn at Stillborn Cave. Old Gudrun's grandmother's charm went this Frostfall. She's beside herself.

objectives.text: Find what takes the charms
objectives.journal: The spirit in the cave was rocking a nest of charms in her arms. When she faded, they spilled across the ice.

objectives.text: Recover Gudrun's cradle-charm
Tie the charm back on the cairn

quests.outro: Gudrun ties a new red thread to the charm, and one more for Asta.

quests.title: The Lost Dispatches
quests.desc: Courier Anvari left Fort Dunstad with troop dispositions for the Pale and was dragged into Duskglow Crevice by the Falmer. The commander needs the case back.
quests.pitch: Fort Dunstad lost a courier to the Falmer at Duskglow. He was carrying something the Legion badly wants back. Commander Rufio's posted a reward.

objectives.text: Recover the dispatch case from Duskglow Crevice
objectives.journal: Anvari kept his promise. The case was under him, still sealed.

objectives.text: Return the dispatches to Fort Dunstad

quests.outro: Commander Rufio sends Anvari's last letter on to his sister in Bruma. Felix pays the nine septims, too, under protest.

quests.title: The Luck of the Brothers
quests.desc: Three brothers called the Lucky went into Ironbind Barrow. Only Thorkel came out. His brothers' pieces of their mother's luck-stone are still inside.
quests.pitch: Thorkel the Lucky sits at Nightgate Inn every night drinking to his brothers. They're still inside Ironbind Barrow. He says he can't go home until the luck-stone's whole.

objectives.text: Find Bjorn and the two pieces of the luck-stone
objectives.journal: Bjorn died in the burial hall with both pieces in his fist.

objectives.text: Lay the iron-masked warlord to rest
Bring the pieces to Thorkel at Nightgate Inn
objectives.topic: Bjorn kept Ivar's piece and his own. Here.
objectives.reply: Whole again. Mother said it would bring us home. It brought me home, I suppose. Bjorn always said I'd be the last one standing at the bar. Let me buy you that drink.

quests.outro: Thorkel goes home to his mother's farm. He does not call himself Lucky anymore.

quests.title: The Last Verse
quests.desc: Halla Sweet-Voice, a skald of Dawnstar, went into Silverdrift Lair to copy the lost closing verse of the Saga of the White Strand.
quests.pitch: A skald went into Silverdrift Lair to copy some old verse. The bards in Dawnstar are fretting. Never seen so many people worried about a poem.

objectives.text: Find the tablet of the White Strand
objectives.journal: Halla never finished her copy. Her charcoal was still on the tablet, half the verse traced out.

objectives.text: Defeat the barrow's keeper
Bring the tablet to the skalds of Dawnstar

quests.outro: That winter Dawnstar hears the Saga of the White Strand sung to its end for the first time in four hundred years. The final verse is dedicated to Halla.

quests.title: The Fox's Purse
quests.desc: Saervi the Fox, a smuggler, hid her brandy money near Yorgrim Overlook under a stone marked with a fox.
quests.pitch: There was a smuggler, Saervi, used Yorgrim Overlook as a lookout. Legion caught her last spring. Her purse, they never found.

objectives.text: Find the fox-marked stone under the leaning pine
objectives.journal: Under the fox-scratched stone: a leather purse and a silver ring.

quests.outro: You do not spend it all on mead at Nightgate Inn. Most of it, perhaps.

quests.title: The Bear-and-Axe Banner
quests.desc: Kolbeinn Rime-Hand deserted the Pale Stormcloak camp with the company banner and fled into Forsaken Cave rather than march against his cousin.
quests.pitch: A Stormcloak boy ran into Forsaken Cave with his company's banner. The sergeant wants the banner back. She's quieter about wanting the boy.

objectives.text: Find the banner in Forsaken Cave
Defeat the crowned draugr on the throne
objectives.journal: Kolbeinn was dead before you reached him, curled up behind the throne. He had kept the banner off the floor.

objectives.text: Return the banner to the Pale Stormcloak Camp

quests.outro: Sergeant Gunnvor reads Kolbeinn's journal and burns it. 'He died guarding the colours,' she tells the company. Nobody contradicts her.

quests.title: The Sea-Wolf's Blessing
quests.desc: Ragnhild Keel-Wright of Windhelm believes the prow carving from Yngol's ship can bless a new vessel against the Sea of Ghosts. She asks for it to be brought from Yngol Barrow.
quests.pitch: There's a shipwright in Windhelm who's lost a husband to the sea. She wants something from Yngol Barrow to bless her sons' new boat. Strange request. Grieving folk make them.

objectives.text: Recover the sea-wolf carving from Yngol Barrow
objectives.journal: The sea-wolf's head hung above Yngol's empty bier. Its oak was still warm, as if from sun on a deck.

objectives.text: Bring the carving to Ragnhild in Windhelm
objectives.topic: I have the sea-wolf from Yngol's ship.
objectives.reply: You took it from his tomb? I asked for it, I know. But now that it's here, it feels like stealing from the dead. What should I do?

choices.label: Touch it to the keel, then I'll return it
choices.reply: Yes. A blessing borrowed, not stolen. Bring it back to him when the keel is laid. My sons will know whose luck they sail with.

choices.label: Keep it. Your sons need it more than he does
choices.reply: Perhaps. The dead have the sea already. Let the living have a little of its mercy. I'll set it in the prow myself.

quests.outro: Ragnhild's ship is launched in Sun's Height. She names it Yngol's Luck.

quests.title: The Stolen Heartwood
quests.desc: A greedy woodcutter cut heartwood from the eldest tree of the Shrouded Grove, and its spriggan has turned savage. Liv Moss-Mother says the heartwood must go back.
quests.pitch: Old Liv the herb-woman says someone cut the heart out of the great tree in the Shrouded Grove, and the tree-women have gone mad over it. She wants it put right, not burned out.

objectives.text: Take the heartwood back from the woodcutters' camp
objectives.journal: The woodcutters were drying the heartwood by their fire to sell as alchemy stock. It still pulses faintly.

objectives.text: Return the heartwood to the eldest tree
objectives.journal: When the heartwood touched the trunk, the black rot drained from the elder spriggan's bark like ink washed from a page.

quests.outro: Liv leaves a jar of honey at the grove's edge. In the morning it is empty, and a sprig of snowberries lies beside it.

quests.title: The Tonal Regulator
quests.desc: Quaestor Aurelian Vesk of the College has commissioned the recovery of a Dwemer tonal regulator from the lower halls of Raldbthar.
quests.pitch: That College scholar, Vesk, has been posting commissions for some brass rod in Raldbthar. Bandits upstairs, machines downstairs. Pays well, if you live.

objectives.text: Fight through the bandits in the upper halls
Recover the tonal regulator from the lower halls
Deliver the regulator to Quaestor Vesk at the College
objectives.reply: Listen to it. Listen! The same note as Alftand, to the hair. The lifts, the ruins, all of it, one machine under the Pale. Eleven years. Eleven years, and they called it a hobby.

quests.outro: Vesk's twelfth memorandum to the Arch-Mage receives a reply at last. It says: 'Fine.'

quests.title: The Chieftain's Horn
quests.desc: A grave-robber stole Hillgrund's drinking horn from his bier and woke the tomb. Hillgrund's descendants can no longer bury their dead there.
quests.pitch: Hillgrund's kin can't lay their dead in the old tomb anymore. Something's awake in there, and they say it's looking for a stolen horn.

objectives.text: Find the stolen horn in the side passage
objectives.journal: The robber never left the side passage. The horn lay in his lap.

objectives.text: Face the wakened chieftain
Return the horn to Hillgrund's bier
objectives.journal: The horn is back on the bier. The tomb is silent.

quests.outro: In spring, Ingrun Hillgrund-Kin lays Torvar's urn with the rest of the line. Nothing stirs.

quests.title: The Steaming Mound
quests.desc: The dragon mound south of the Pale Imperial Camp steams in the frost, and the Legion picket has seen ancient warriors standing on it at night.
quests.pitch: The Legion's frightened of an old grave south of their coast camp. Warriors standing on it at night, steam coming off it like breath. Somebody should look before something climbs out.

objectives.text: Investigate the dragon mound
Destroy the mound's guardians
Defeat the mound-warden
objectives.journal: The warden fell, and the steam over the mound thinned and died. Whatever lies beneath sleeps on, for now.

quests.outro: Decurion Tellus puts in a report. Quartermaster Ostorian files it under 'Do not mention to the Legate'.
